metadata.description: Explore Bloom courses and single sessions in one place.

Library.title: Explore the library
Library.introduction: Everything from Bloom in one place — guided courses to work through step by step, and single sessions you can explore whenever you need them.

noResults.title: No matches for those filters
noResults.body: Try removing a filter or two, or explore a different theme — there’s more waiting in the library.

recognising-harm.label: Recognising harm
recognising-harm.blurb: Naming harm in relationships and everyday life
recognising-harm.description: Harm isn’t always obvious. Explore what abuse and coercion can look like in relationships and everyday life, and find language for experiences that have been hard to name.

why-harm-happens.label: Why harm happens
why-harm-happens.blurb: Learn about the social and systemic forces behind abuse
why-harm-happens.description: Abuse is shaped by more than one person’s choices. Understand the social, cultural, and systemic forces that allow harm to happen — and why none of it is your fault.

body-after-trauma.label: Your body after trauma
body-after-trauma.blurb: How trauma lives in the body
body-after-trauma.description: Trauma lives in the body as much as the mind. Learn how your nervous system responds to what you’ve been through, and gentle, body-based ways to feel safer.

setting-boundaries.label: Setting boundaries
setting-boundaries.blurb: Emotional, physical, sexual, and digital boundaries
setting-boundaries.description: Boundaries protect your wellbeing across every part of life. Explore how to recognise, set, and hold emotional, physical, sexual, and digital boundaries.

healing-journey.label: Your healing journey
healing-journey.blurb: Finding your way through grief, growth, and recovery
healing-journey.description: Healing isn’t linear. Find companionship and tools for moving through grief, growth, and recovery at whatever pace feels right for you.

staying-safe.label: Staying safe now
staying-safe.blurb: Safety planning and coping with ongoing abuse
staying-safe.description: If you’re still in or near harm, safety comes first. Find practical support for safety planning and for coping when things feel unsafe right now.

support.title: Get support
support.introduction: Prefer to talk to someone? Bloom’s support services are here whenever you need them.

messaging.title: 1-to-1 messaging
messaging.description: Thoughtful replies to your questions and reflections, from our multilingual team, within 1–2 days.

notes.title: Notes from Bloom
notes.description: Support from Bloom, delivered to your WhatsApp twice a week.
